description: This file contains API utility functions for fetching data related to projects, metrics, and suggestions in a documentation quality dashboard frontend. It includes environment configuration, HTTP request helpers, data seed functions, and exported functions for the UI to interact with backend services.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for API calls based on environment variables or window location.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Generic function to fetch JSON data from a given API endpoint and handle errors.

methods.name: seedProjects
methods.description: Provides a static list of seed project data used when the API is unavailable.

methods.name: seedMetrics
methods.description: Provides sample metrics data for a given project, used as fallback.

methods.name: seedSuggestions
methods.description: Provides sample suggestions data for a given project, used as fallback.

methods.name: fetchProjects
methods.description: Fetches list of projects from backend or returns seeded data if backend is unavailable.

methods.name: fetchMetrics
methods.description: Fetches metrics data for a specific project or returns seeded data on failure.

methods.name: fetchSuggestions
methods.description: Fetches suggestions for a specific project or returns seeded data on failure.

methods.name: getResolvedApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the current API base URL used in the frontend environment.
